name: room-booking-api

dependencies.name: booking-db
dependencies.description: Stores the office's rooms and the Members' bookings.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in: the gateway validates the Member's token and forwards the signed assertion this service verifies.

description: Owns rooms and bookings for the shared office. Seeds the fixed set of rooms at start, lists and searches rooms, reports a room's busy times, and creates, lists and cancels the signed-in Member's own bookings, refusing clashes, over-capacity, past starts and a third upcoming booking. One deployable because it is the single owner of the booking data; it does not manage rooms through any operation, issue tokens, or render any UI.
